scope: v1 observation = python/mini_motorways_env.py encode_observation (15 tile channels x 777 tiles + 11 globals). Evidence: 48 native capture states (research/s7_long_route/native_normal_start_captures.jsonl.gz), 3,867 native decisions with per-step logs (research/s13_multi_house/raw), S11 Mothballed probe, plugin source Entrypoint.cs:3160-3248.

tile_channels.name: buildable
tile_channels.finding: 1 on every tile incl. House/Destination/Carpark/Tree tiles (96/96 carpark tiles buildable=true in captures). Carries only terrain buildability; occupancy is not encoded here.

tile_channels.name: overWater
tile_channels.finding: correct; synthetic S7/S13 use the captured water mask

tile_channels.name: underMountain
tile_channels.finding: always 0 on the S7-S13 map; legitimate on other maps

tile_channels.name: road N/E/S/W
tile_channels.native_source: tile.GetTwoLaneRoadStateInDirection -> ordinal/3 (None 0, Pending 1/3, Active 2/3, Mothballed 3/3, VisiblyActive 2/3)
tile_channels.finding: Active and Mothballed are DISTINCT values (0.667 vs 1.0), so functional vs inactive roads are separable; the ordinal scale is odd (Mothballed > Active) but not a collapse. Pending never observed in 3,867 decisions. Synthetic S13 encodes Mothballed as 1.0 identically (gate B4/B6).
tile_channels.fix: none for S14; a one-hot road-state split would be cleaner but changes semantics -> not done

tile_channels.name: hasTrafficLight
tile_channels.finding: never non-zero in logs (no light upgrades taken); synthetic 0

tile_channels.name: contentType ordinal/2
tile_channels.finding: COLLAPSE: Carpark (96 tiles / 48 states) and Tree (384 tiles) map to 0 = empty land. The policy cannot see the carpark that terminates every route (it sees only the stub road edge) nor trees. Natively ADD on a carpark tile is illegal (mask) so no illegal action results, but the state is ambiguous (a stub edge next to 'empty land').
tile_channels.fix: proposed for a later migration: separate Carpark / Tree values or channels (changes channel-10 semantics -> breaks S8-C equivalence; NOT done in S14). S7/S13 synthetic envs replicate the native collapse (carpark content 0), so native and synthetic agree today.

tile_channels.name: hasGroupIndex
tile_channels.finding: ROOT CAUSE: identity collapsed to a flag at mini_motorways_env.py:114; the plugin emits the integer per tile (Entrypoint.cs:3211-3223). 76% of native decisions have >=2 destination groups and >=1 house -> median 64 house->group assignments consistent with one v1 observation.
tile_channels.fix: obs v2: 6 appended one-hot group-slot channels (order of first appearance); channel 11 kept unchanged

tile_channels.name: destTotalDemandNorm = totalDemand/50 clipped
tile_channels.finding: max observed 10 (overcrowding at 7) -> the channel uses 0..0.2 of its range. Not a collapse (integer steps of 0.02 remain distinct). Synthetic S13 identical formula.

tile_channels.name: destOvercrowding
tile_channels.finding: correct; overcrowdingTime (seconds already overcrowded) is in the JSON but not encoded -> the policy cannot see how close the game-over timer is
tile_channels.fix: candidate extra channel for a later migration; not added in S14 (keep the change minimal and testable)

tile_channels.name: visibleVehicleCount/10
tile_channels.finding: native-only information; synthetic S7/S13 = 0 (no traffic model). Policy trained synthetically never saw non-zero values; natively up to 17 vehicles total per step were seen.
tile_channels.fix: documented; traffic is out of scope

tile_channels.name: motorwayDirections, destination.isUpgraded, destinationType (TrainStation/BoatTerminal), overcrowdingTime, totalClaimedPackages
tile_channels.finding: absent from v1; none observed non-trivial on this map except overcrowdingTime

tile_channels.name: contentType Destination with groupIndex null
tile_channels.native_source: 8 tiles in 2/12 replicate episodes (upper 2x2 of a 2x4 destination block)
tile_channels.finding: v1: content=Destination, has-group 0; v2: no slot. Synthetic S13 sets has-group=1 on all destination tiles (differs from native on these 8 tiles in 2 of 36 scenarios; not covered by gate B6 sampling).
tile_channels.fix: documented; s13_env not modified (frozen S13 artifact)

global_features.name: hour/24
global_features.finding: clock.Hour is CUMULATIVE (max 681 -> 28.4), not clipped; grows linearly with decisions. Synthetic S13 matches (int(1.2t)+1)/24; S7 used hour mod 24 (documented S7 difference).

global_features.name: concrete available/total
global_features.finding: correct; total grows with top-ups so the ratio is not the absolute count (25 and 45 available can both be 1.0)

global_features.name: pendingUpgradeChoices/3
global_features.finding: non-zero in 22/3867 native steps; synthetic always 0 (upgrades not modelled)

synthetic_vs_native.present_synthetically_unavailable_native: none: every synthetic channel is computed from quantities the native JSON also carries; gate B6 shows the frozen native v1 encoder reproduces the S13 v2 observation bit-for-bit from a native-style rendering of the synthetic state (644/644 states)

cnn_consumption.finding: SpatialExtractor: three 3x3 convolutions -> 7x7 receptive field for every per-tile action logit; only mean/max pooling reaches the WAIT/upgrade/value heads. Group channels therefore inform a tile logit only about houses/destinations within 3 tiles. A road frontier more than 3 tiles from both the house and the destination cannot see which group it serves, even under v2.
cnn_consumption.fix: candidate for a later migration (larger receptive field / dilated convs); not part of this phase
